Each field is associated with a specific keyframe or local region.

**Tracking:** Perform sparse visual tracking to estimate camera poses.
**Mapping:** For each new frame, render the scene using the current neural fields anchored to the pose graph.
**Loop Closure & Deformation:** When a loop closure is detected, update the pose graph.
The neural fields deform according to the updated poses to maintain consistency.
**Rendering:** To render a point $\mathbf{x}$, identify the relevant neural fields based on the current pose graph.
